INTEGRATED PHYSICAL SECURITY UPGRADES FOR THE DPEARTMENT OF HOMELAND SECURITY (DHS) TRANSPORTATION SECURITY LABORATORY (TSL)  

  NOTE: THIS IS A REQUEST FOR INFORMATION (RFI) ONLY.  

 This RFI is issued solely for information and market research planning purposes.  This RFI shall not be construed as an obligation on the part of the Government.  This is NOT a Request for Quotations or Request for Proposals (RFQ or RFP).  No solicitation document exists and the Government may or may not issue a formal solicitation as a result of any information received in response to this RFI. 

 The Government will not pay for any response or demonstration expenses.  All costs incurred responding to this RFI will be solely at the interested parties expense.  Failure to respond to this RFI will not preclude participation in any future solicitation.  In accordance with Revolutionary Federal Acquisition Regulation (RFO) Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR) 15.201(e), responses to this notice are not offers and cannot be accepted by the Government to form a binding contract.  Any information received will become the property of the Government and will not be returned to the interested party. Interested parties are responsible for adequately marking proprietary or sensitive information. 

 The Government’s explicit intent, in this RFI, is to not receive from interested vendors any proprietary data, trade secrets, business sensitive information, or information considered CONFIDENTIAL under 18 U.S.C. §1905. The Government’s constraint does not in any way relieve interested parties from their responsibility to properly mark proprietary data when it is provided, nor does it alleviate any requirement for the Government to protect marked data.  The Government is not obligated to protect unmarked data. 

 The information provided in this RFI is subject to change and is not binding on the Government.  All submissions become the property of the Government and will not be returned. 

  I.  BACKGROUND  

 The United States Department of Homeland Security (DHS) Science and Technology (S&T) Directorate Office of National Laboratories (ONL) Transportation Security Laboratory (TSL) is seeking information for Integrated Physical Security Upgrades. 

  II.  PURPOSE OF RFI  

 The purposes of this RFI are to: 

 1.  Identify qualified small-business and other-than-small business vendors capable of providing Integrated Physical Security Upgrades for the DHS ONL TSL in accordance with the attached draft Statement of Work (SOW); and 

 2.  Assess the capability, experience, capacity, and socioeconomic status of potential sources; and support the development of the Government’s acquisition strategy. 

  III.  INFORMATION REQUESTED   

 1.  Describe your experience and capability to provide services in the following scope areas: 

 
	 Scope A – Video Surveillance (Analo Camera Replacement) 
	 Scope B – Replace Video Monitors 
	 Scope C – Video Management Servers and Licensing 
	 Scope D – Lenel OnGuard Visitor Management System 
	 Scope E – Access Control Expansion (Additional Card Readers) 
	 Scope F – Card Reader Replacement (OSDP Encryption) 
	 Scope G – Portable Field Armory 
	 Scope H – Video Next CCTV Site Migration (Buildings 315 and 374) 
 

 2.  Small businesses with only partial capabilities of this requirement are encouraged to submit their capabilities demonstrating the portion (scope) of the requirement you are capable of providing. This information will allow the Government to identify possible subcontracting opportunities. 

 3.  Large businesses are encouraged to identify task areas for possible subcontracting opportunities. 

  IV.  SUBMISSION INFORMATION  

 Interested parties are invited to provide responses pertaining to the services identified in this RFI. The total submission page count shall not exceed  eight (8)  pages, Times New Roman, Font Size 12, excluding the cover page. Only one submission will be reviewed per interested parties for this RFI. Only electronic submissions will be accepted. Emails with attachments larger than 5 MB shall be broken down into multiple emails with no one attachment exceeding 5 MB. 

 Submission shall be either in Microsoft Word or Adobe PDF, must be legible when viewed at 100% magnification on a computer screen in the application native to the submission’s file type (e.g. (*.pdf) Adobe Acrobat or (*.doc/x) Microsoft Word.  

 Each electronic submission shall include: 

 -  RFI number “ 70RSAT27RFI000004 Integrated Physical Security Upgrades for the DHS TSL”  in the Subject Line; 

 -  If the submission includes more than one electronic email, please include the file number and total files being submitted (e.g., File 1 of 4, File 2 of 4, etc.) in the Subject Line; 

 -  Responses must have a cover page that includes the following information: 

 
	 Vendor Name 
	 Address 
	 RFI Point of Contact, phone number, and email address 
	 SAM Unique Entity Identifier (UEI) Number 
	 Business Size and Socioeconomic Status: The proposed North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) code for this effort is 561621 – Security Systems Services. State the vendors business size under NAICS 561621 and identify all applicable socioeconomic designations, including, as applicable:
	 
		 Small Business; 
		 Small Disadvantaged Business; 
		 8(a) Program Participant; 
		 Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned Small Business; 
		 Historically Underutilized Business Zone Small Business; 
		 Woman-Owned Small Business; and/or 
		 Economically Disadvantaged Woman-Owned Small Business 
	 
	 
 

 - Contracting Vehicles: Identify any active Federal Supply Schedules (FSS), Governmentwide Acquisition Contracts (GWAC), Blanket Purchase Agreements, Indefinite-Delivery Indefinite-Quantity contract
